fields.minNoticeHelp: How many minutes before an appointment start time a customer must book. Example: 60 means bookings must be made at least 1 hour ahead.
fields.minNoticeTooltip: Used by the scheduling engine to reject last-minute bookings. Set to 0 to allow bookings up to the last available slot.
fields.maxWindowHelp: How many days into the future customers can see and book appointments.
fields.maxWindowTooltip: Prevents bookings too far ahead. Example: 90 days limits the calendar to roughly three months.
fields.slotIntervalHelp: Spacing between generated appointment start times. Shorter intervals offer more choices; longer intervals simplify the schedule.
fields.slotIntervalTooltip: The slot engine uses this value when building available times from working hours. Must be between 5 and 480 minutes.
fields.bufferBeforeHelp: Minutes blocked before each appointment so staff can prepare the room or review the chart.
fields.bufferBeforeTooltip: Reduces visible slots that would start too close to a prior booking when preparation time is needed.
fields.bufferAfterHelp: Minutes blocked after each appointment for cleanup, notes, or turnover.
fields.bufferAfterTooltip: Extends the blocked period beyond the service duration so back-to-back bookings leave no gap for staff.
fields.minCancellationNoticeHelp: How many minutes before the appointment a customer may cancel. Example: 240 means cancellation is allowed only if the appointment starts more than 4 hours later.
fields.minCancellationNoticeTooltip: Future booking channels (public booking, WhatsApp, AI) will enforce this rule. Set to 0 to allow cancellation at any time before the appointment.
fields.minRescheduleNoticeHelp: How many minutes before the appointment a customer may move it to another time. Example: 720 means rescheduling is allowed only more than 12 hours before start.
fields.minRescheduleNoticeTooltip: The booking domain will use this when validating reschedule requests. Set to 0 to allow rescheduling at any time before the appointment.
fields.allowOverbookingHelp: When enabled, more than one booking may occupy the same time slot if your availability rules permit it.
fields.allowOverbookingTooltip: Use only if your clinic intentionally double-books resources. Most clinics should leave this off.
fields.timezoneHelp: The timezone your clinic operates in. Appointment times are shown to staff and customers in this zone.
fields.timezoneTooltip: Appointment timestamps are stored in UTC in the database. This setting controls how local business hours and slot labels are calculated and displayed.
fields.weekStartHelp: The first day shown on weekly calendars and availability views.
fields.weekStartTooltip: Common choices are Monday for business weeks or Sunday for regional calendars.

examples.cancellationNotice: 240 minutes = customers may cancel only if the appointment is more than 4 hours away.
examples.rescheduleNotice: 720 minutes = rescheduling allowed only more than 12 hours before the appointment.

docs.overview: These rules apply company-wide. They do not replace individual staff schedules—those are configured under Resources and Availability.
docs.timezoneRecommendation: Recommendation: select your clinic's local timezone (e.g. Africa/Cairo). Times are stored securely in UTC; this setting only affects how hours and slots are shown and calculated for your business.
